newsitem.title: USA: NextWave, LCC reach pact on note payment.
newsitem.headline: NextWave, LCC reach pact on note payment.

text.p: NextWave Telecom Inc, a top bidder in the auctions for next-generation U.S. wireless licences, said LCC International Inc and it had agreed to extend payment terms on a $5.9 million note NextWave owed LCC.
The note covered services LCC is to provide NextWare in connection with the provision of engineering and program management services for the construction of its wireless network.
Under the terms of the deal, NextWave said it will pay LCC the $5.9 million note and other trade payables over an unspecified, extended period of time.
